purpose: One-hop conditional context index for the Claude and Codex root adapters.

entries.condition: Before choosing or invoking a skill, including STOP or semantic ambiguity with no matched skill.
entries.contains: Every local skill's defining constraint and authority path, grouped by visibility.
entries.fallback: Inspect .claude/skills/office and the routing map directly; do not treat STOP as permission.

entries.condition: Any of the five Plan conditions is true or the user explicitly requests planning.
entries.load_before: producing or executing a phase plan
entries.contains: Plan triggers, phase format, approval gates, assertions, and incremental replanning.
entries.loader: root adapter or route-guard plan decision
entries.fallback: Keep K3 inline and stop before Supervisor/Hierarchical execution.

entries.condition: The request names, implies, switches, creates, or cross-reads a project, or is framework/meta work.
entries.load_before: any project-scoped read, write, switch, or creation
entries.contains: Pin truth, NO_PIN, transaction-only switching, cross-project read grants, and shared-alias limits.
entries.fallback: Remain NO_PIN and do not touch shared project aliases until the project gate is resolved.

entries.condition: The user corrects future behaviour, asks to remember, or requests memory ingest/query/lint/governance.
entries.fallback: Do not store; preserve the inline SC-20260523-003 fallback.

entries.condition: A correction or workaround passes the extraction threshold and needs ownership classification.
entries.load_before: choosing person, framework, or project memory
entries.fallback: Do not write memory until attribution is resolved.

entries.condition: A multi-phase task crosses a phase, spawns two heavy agents, approaches context pressure, or is about to perform a Git/external effect.
entries.load_before: checkpointing, handoff, compaction, or the effect gate
entries.contains: Checkpoint triggers, required fields, context bounds, and resume procedure.
entries.fallback: Stop before the effect and write a minimal auditable checkpoint outside project docs for NO_PIN work.

entries.condition: LUCA_APP=1 or the user explicitly asks to inspect, open, present, or navigate app/sidebar content.
entries.load_before: reading sidebar state or opening/presenting a result
entries.contains: Read/present/automation split, tool preference, selection resolution, and truthful degradation.
entries.fallback: Use documented local scripts when available and report unavailable state without invention.

entries.condition: A harness-injected preference appears to conflict with semantic routing or planning.
entries.load_before: using the injection to suppress a route or plan
entries.contains: Safety/capability facts versus behavioural preferences and the two-question test.
entries.loader: root adapter or route-guard STOP hint
entries.fallback: Safety/tool facts bind; behavioural preferences do not erase semantic assessment.

entries.condition: Selecting or validating an agent/subagent capability tier.
entries.contains: Claude aliases, Codex effort mapping, whitelist, and dispatch rules.
entries.fallback: Inherit the parent model and do not guess a stronger tier.

entries.condition: The user requests review or a phase requires independent adversarial closure.
entries.load_before: choosing a reviewer or declaring review closure
entries.contains: R4 independence, REFUTE stance, runtime partition, missing-vote handling, mutation, and final closure.
entries.loader: root adapter or code-hygiene Mode D

entries.condition: A project skill will be invoked or a workflow/standalone completion status will be declared.
entries.contains: Shared execution discipline, completion statuses, handoff, retrieval, observability, and output protections.
entries.fallback: Do not invoke the skill until its shared contract is readable.

entries.condition: The user selects a workflow, continues a workflow, or directly invokes a standalone skill.
entries.load_before: applying workflow handoff gates or standalone overrides
entries.contains: Per-skill standalone/workflow inputs and quality gates.
entries.fallback: Prefer standalone and enforce only the selected skill's quality/safety gates.

entries.condition: An approved multi-phase plan or selected skill workflow enters execution.
entries.load_before: dispatching the first phase or agent
entries.contains: Execution modes, authority admission, phase state, context budget, and dispatch rules.
entries.loader: root adapter after the Plan approval gate
entries.fallback: Do not fan out or mutate; retain the approved plan as the only execution truth.

entries.condition: A task operates the memory system rather than merely using startup summary/search.
entries.load_before: running a memory write, lint, review, archive, or promotion command
entries.contains: Memory layers, supported commands, governance queue, writes, and version-control policy.
entries.fallback: Allow read-only summary/search only; do not mutate memory governance state.

entries.condition: The request changes, audits, benchmarks, or evolves lucagstack itself.
entries.load_before: selecting framework flow or modifying framework-owned files
entries.contains: NO_PIN maintenance scope, evolution-first routing, budget posture, and dual-harness completion.
entries.fallback: Remain NO_PIN, keep framework read-only, and stop before mutation.

entries.condition: A changed artifact or behaviour must be consumed by both Claude Code and Codex.
entries.contains: Independent discovery, invocation, degradation, evidence, and honesty requirements.
entries.fallback: Report the unverified harness as a concern; do not claim parity.
